title: What people frame, ii
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
logline: A wedding photo, 1971. The couple is still married. That's the whole job.

panels.composition: The counter. An older COUPLE, together, with a photograph: themselves, 1971, a wedding on a dock. The dock is the one at the boat launch.

image.prompt: an older couple at a frame-shop counter handing over a 1971 wedding photograph to a young man, black and white

panels.composition: The photo: the dock, the couple, younger than Wood is now. The shack behind them, new.
props: the photo: a 1971 wedding on the boat-launch dock

image.prompt: close-up of a 1971 black-and-white wedding photograph of a young couple on a wooden dock with a new-looking shingle shack behind them
a young man looking up from a photograph with recognition at an older couple

panels.composition: Wood cutting the mat. Silent. The couple waiting, her hand on his arm, exactly as in the photo.

characters.pose: waiting, her hand on his arm
